Messages.Author: cofius
Messages.Body: when a minion calls referendum by a charming lobby, does he gains vote from a political card also? thank you...

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
No, but the Methuselah playing the political action card does.

Name: Charming Lobby
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Presence
+1 stealth political action.
This vampire calls a referendum listed on a political action card in your hand (play that card) or allowed by an effect in play. If the referendum passes, then the next referendum called by any vampire thereafter passes automatically.
As above, and this vampire gains 2 votes in that first referendum.

Rulebook 6.3.3.1 wrote:
>
> Political Action Cards. Each Methuselah may gain one vote by using a political action card. These cards say "worth 1 vote" to indicate this. If a political action card was used to call the referendum, that card provides a vote for the acting vampire's controller. Other political action cards used for votes are simply burned without regard to the text on the cards. Each Methuselah can gain no more than 1 vote from political action cards.
>
